$comment: Reviewed default price book for the JustOne provider, seeded into the
control plane on first deploy and never overwritten afterwards.
REVIEW NOTE: these unit costs are carried over from the previous
MX_INSIGHT_JUSTONE_BILLING_JSON example and are NOT confirmed against a
JustOne procurement contract. They flow into the cost ledger, so replace
them with the real per-endpoint prices before production dispatch, and
move pricingAsOf to the date that review happened.
unitCostMinor is in minor units of `currency` (CNY: 1 = 0.01 yuan).
Every released endpoint key needs a positive price; a missing key leaves
its whole operation blocked. `bash scripts/manage.sh ops
internal-production deploy` reports any key this file does not cover.
